run_optical_flow_inference: run optical flow inference between image pairs using FlowNet2 with optional homography warping via CLI
create_flowinfer_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset class that loads image pairs from a list file for flow inference
detect_and_describe_features: detect and describe SURF keypoints and features from an image using OpenCV
match_keypoints_homography: match keypoints between two images using Lowe's ratio test and compute homography with RANSAC
compute_homography_flow: compute optical flow between an image and a homography-registered version of another image
